description.narrative: The Project will support Santander Mexico in considerably growing its sustainable portfolio, thanks to the release of the regulatory capital that Santander Mexico would otherwise have been required to hold against assets included in the reference portfolio. IFC anticipates that the Project will contribute to strengthening market resilience by introducing a relatively new capital instrument to the market that enables banking institutions to optimize capitalization while also supporting an expansion of lending to strategic areas in Mexico.

The proposed investment consists of a Synthetic Risk Transfer (SRT) in which IFC will provide to Banco Santander Mexico S.A. (Santander Mexico or the Bank) an unfunded guarantee on credit losses up to MXN1.6 billion (US$88.1 million equivalent), representing the mezzanine tranche of a MXN27.4 billion (US$1.5 billion equivalent) reference portfolio from the Banks eligible credit exposures. IFCs guarantee will enable the Bank to use the regulatory capital freed up through the reference portfolio to generate more risk-weighted assets and support its sustainable origination lending activities (the Project).
